title: The fixed comparison for a nested restricted pullback square
statement: Construct the natural comparison between restricted derived pullback and exact nested open restriction by pasting inclusion comparisons and fixed derived-pullback composition across the commuting restricted scheme square.

source.place: Compatibility of derived pullback and open restriction; composition as in Tag 0D5S.

proof.text: The two restricted scheme maps agree after the larger target open immersion. Cancel that monomorphism to prove the square.

Whisker with the inverse source inclusion comparison, compose the two pullback composition isomorphisms across equality of the square, then whisker with the target inclusion comparison. This is explicit data, with no existence choice.
